title: Oozy Uruguayan Fish Empanadas
description: Pungent and pillowy empanadas filled with fish sauce and made with long fermentation dough, this Uruguayan dish is a show off, featuring ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients, perfect for a dinner party

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: use a high quality fish sauce

instructions: Combine warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl and let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated
Add flour, salt, and eggs to the bowl and mix until a shaggy dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Let the dough ferment for 2 hours until it has doubled in size
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a spoonful of fish sauce, chopped onion, and minced garlic in the center
Place a piece of fish fillet on top of the filling and fold the dough over to form a half moon shape
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash and bake for 20 minutes until golden brown
